edition.title: Cum novus ac distinctus alter vicariatus — Guillelmo Dusarre coadiutor vicarii apostolici Oceaniae Centralis (CLXXII) — Rome: Ex Typographia Polyglotta S. C. de Propaganda Fide, 1902.

work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter CLXXII names Guillaume Dusarre coadjutor of the elect Pierre Bataillon; address, intitulation, body, full non obstantibus and dating clause survive. Its provenance note1 is LF32433. It shares date, addressee and purpose with CLXX (LF32180–32244) but its wording differs (e.g. “integritate vitae, religione, pietate, prudentia” and a full non obstantibus clause); each printed witness is reviewed separately and no identity join is asserted. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF32356–32356; the source dating clause at LF32418–32422 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima tertia augusti millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo secundo, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo se- cundo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
